title: Ongoing Equipment Rentals and Hardship Assistance — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Program terms.** When a patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account carries a hardship approval in force, ongoing-rental points are added to the hardship assistance percentage for the monthly equipment rentals the patient holds with Summit Ridge.

**What is counted.** A wheelchair record (Mobility Equipment), an oxygen record (Home Oxygen Therapy) and a PAP device record (PAP Therapy Equipment) that is rental active. Each such record in rental-active status counts as one rental.

| Rental-active records among the wheelchair, oxygen and PAP device records | Points added to the assistance percentage |
|---|---|
| two or more | 8 |
| exactly one | 5 |
| none | 0 |

The points enlarge the assistance percentage itself, which is then applied once; they are not a separate discount.

## Cases (hypothetical patients)

- Oxygen record rental active and PAP device record rental active, no wheelchair: two rentals, 8 points.
- Wheelchair record rental active; the PAP device is owned by the patient: one rental, 5 points.
- Wheelchair record suspended; no oxygen or PAP device record: no rental-active record, 0 points.
- All three records rental active: two or more, 8 points.
